999008199.text:
よう、船乗りの兄ちゃん。
同業者として聞きてぇことがあるんだが、いいか？

localizations.en: Hey there, sailor. As a fellow seafaring man, I've got some questions for you. Mind if I ask?

999008199.text:
うん？　あんたも船乗りかい。ここらじゃ
見慣れない顔だが……できるな

localizations.en: Hm? You're a sailor too? Haven't seen your face around these parts... but you've got the look.

999008199.text:
ま、ちと遠くから来たもんでな。この先にあるっつう
「果ての大陸」について教えてほしいんだが……

localizations.en: Well, I've come from pretty far away. I'm hoping you can tell me about this World's End that's supposed to be out there...

999008199.text: 果ての大陸？　なんだそりゃ

海の果てにあるっていう、手つかずのお宝が眠る島だ。
そういう話、聞いたことねえか？

localizations.en: An untouched island at the edge of the sea, sleeping treasures and all that. Ever heard tales like that?

999008199.text:
そりゃ、財宝の伝説なんてのはごまんとあるぜ。
この辺りは数え切れないくらい島があるしな

localizations.en: Sure, there are countless treasure legends around here. This area's got more islands than you can count.

999008199.text:
中には、色んな理由で立ち入り禁止の島もある。
そういう所には、色んな噂が立ったりするもんさ

localizations.en: Some of them are off-limits for various reasons. Places like that tend to attract all kinds of rumors.

999008199.text: ほう……詳しく聞かせてもらえるか？
ランツェさん、そちらはどうでしたか？

localizations.en: Lanze, how did things go on your end?

999008199.text:
噂やら伝説やら、色々話は聞けたが、
どれも果ての大陸とは関係なさそうだったな

localizations.en: I heard plenty of rumors and legends, but none of them seemed connected to World's End.

999008199.text:
そもそも、果ての大陸の伝説自体、
無数島群域ではあまり知られていないみたいです

localizations.en: It seems like the World's End legend itself isn't very well known in the Infinite Island Chain.

999008199.text:
まぁ、まだ諦めるのは早いぜ。
どっかに知ってる奴くらいいるだろ

localizations.en: Well, it's too early to give up. There's gotta be someone out there who knows something.

999008199.text: 根気強く頑張りましょう！

おうよ！　洗っても洗っても落ちない油汚れみたいに
粘り強く聞き込みを続けようぜ！

localizations.en: You bet! We'll be as persistent as grease stains that won't come out no matter how much you scrub!

999008199.text: あ、あんまり喜べないたとえですよ？

localizations.en: That's... not the comparison I would have chosen.

999008199.text:
ありがとう！
また今度会ったときはもっとお話ししようね！

localizations.en: Thank you! Next time we meet, let's chat even more!

999008199.text: うん！　お姉さんもお仕事頑張ってね～！

localizations.en: Sure! Good luck with your work, miss!

999008199.text:
あの一瞬で打ち解けてしまうなんて、
姉様の人心掌握術はすごいわ

localizations.en: To become so friendly in just an instant... Your ability to win people over is remarkable.

999008199.text: お客様と接し続けて幾星霜。案内人稼業の技よね

localizations.en: Years and years of dealing with customers. It's a skill you pick up as a Guide.

999008199.text: 私も、あなたの言うことはなんだか聞いてしまうのよね

localizations.en: I find myself listening to what you say too, somehow.

999008199.text:
果ての大陸についての収穫はナシ。
結局、あの子たちのことばかり聞いちゃった

localizations.en: No luck on World's End. I ended up asking all about those girls instead.

999008199.text:
それぞれ自由に学問を学び、
自由に将来の進路を選ぶ学生たち……か

localizations.en: Students who are free to study what they want and choose their own futures...

999008199.text:
眩しいよね～……。
みんなキラキラしてたもん

localizations.en: It's so dazzling... They were all just sparkling with potential.

999008199.text: 島の外の世界……刺激的だわ

localizations.en: The world beyond our island... It's so exciting.

999008199.text:
他にも島ごとに色んな文化があるんだろうなあ。
これから楽しみ――

localizations.en: I bet every island has its own unique culture. I'm really looking forward to—

999008199.text: ん、姉様
え？　どうしたの、ベップ
後ろ
うわ、やるなぁ、さすが野生児

localizations.en: Whoa, not bad. Your instincts are wild.

999008199.text:
シ、シトリン！？
アンタ、なんでこんな所に！？

localizations.en: C-Citrine?! What are you doing here?!

999008199.text:
私たちの後をつけてたの？
もしかして、襲いかかるつもりだった？

localizations.en: Were you following us? Were you planning to attack?

999008199.text:
あははっ、そんな物騒な真似しないよ～。
僕はただ、偶然ここを通りがかっただけさ～

localizations.en: I wouldn't do anything like that. I just happened to be passing through.

999008199.text: ほら、図書館ではお静かに。じゃあね～

localizations.en: Remember to keep it down in the library. See ya!

999008199.text: ……絶対嘘。アタシたちを見張ってるに決まってる

localizations.en: ...That's definitely a lie. I'm sure you're spying on us.

999008199.text:
見張るって……なんだか、いやらしいわね。
なんのためにかしら？

localizations.en: Spying... You sure put things rather unpleasantly. What would be the point?

999008199.text:
そりゃ、アタシたちが師匠の思惑通りに動いてるか
確認するためっすよ。余計なお世話だっての！

localizations.en: Obviously to make sure we're doing exactly what Master wants. What a pain!
